acceptance_criterion: mean coverage_scaffold_safe over the identical 60-seed protocol (run_repeated_scaffold_conformal.py, sha256 96be585e27428a1f9bec0a7e2c078f9488711df5515790bc24ac35ac97cf0e09, seeds 0..59) >= 0.90

final_repair.method: Training-conditional PAC-corrected split-conformal rank (Vovk 2012), eps=0.05/delta=0.05 reused verbatim from training-conditional-pac-tolerance-openpoly-tg-v1

root_cause_diagnosis: OpenPoly Tg has only 64 unique Bemis-Murcko scaffolds and is extremely scaffold-imbalanced: 2 scaffolds (255 and 71 molecules) cover 73.6% of the 443-molecule corpus. Scaffold-block test assignment therefore swings train_pool size wildly across seeds (n_cal ranges 7-133), making calibration-side repairs that only REWEIGHT or RESTRATIFY existing points (CV+, weighted, Mondrian-by-scaffold-cluster) hit a ceiling around 0.86-0.88: there just aren't enough distinct scaffolds to stratify or reweight against. The repair that worked instead WIDENS the quantile itself using a theoretically-grounded (not outcome-tuned) training-conditional PAC correction already committed to elsewhere in this module.
remaining_gap: Per-seed / worst-case coverage is NOT restored: 18/60 seeds still individually fall below 0.90 (min 0.5566), concentrated on the seeds where the two dominant scaffolds land in test with a small, dissimilar train_pool. This is disclosed in does_not_close on the done receipt. If a future item wants worst-case (not just mean) coverage, that is a new, harder, not-yet-attempted acceptance bar.
constraints_reaffirmed: run_repeated_scaffold_conformal.py must never be modified; only its deterministic split logic may be duplicated

hyperparameters must be derived from calibration-side data/theory BEFORE viewing the 60-seed outcome, never tuned against it -- the accepted repair reuses a pre-existing, already-signed (eps,delta)=(0.05,0.05) pair verbatim; a naive eps=0.10 guess was tried, failed, and was explicitly discarded rather than iterated on
